test_case.test_name: AV1 operating-point/tile/film-grain hardware decode and physical display
test_case.purpose: Validate the approved AV1 operating point and coding tools are supported and hardware-decoded on the exact GPU with deterministic reconstructed output, then displayed without color, grain, tile, timing or edge artifacts, independently from encoding.
required_package: Immutable AV1 input and SHA-256 with container/OBU, sequence header, profile/level/tier, bit depth/chroma, operating point/layers, tile, film-grain, dimensions, color/range, rates/keyframes and frame expectations
Golden `framemd5`, expected timestamps and explicit pre/post-film-grain plus output pixel/color policy
Exact GPU serial/UUID/BDF and architecture, driver/VBIOS and ffmpeg/ffprobe build with positive AV1 NVDEC capability and no-fallback evidence
Bounded scratch/evidence root; approved connector/display/HDR mode/player/capture route and qualified operator
Health/event thresholds, abort criteria and non-destructive recovery
test_case.test_command: PARAMETERIZED REVIEW-LAYER PROCEDURE — do not execute until approved. Verify AV1 input/golden hashes, capacity, exact GPU architecture/capability and baseline without clearing logs. Record `ffprobe -v error -show_streams -show_format -show_frames -select_streams v:0 -of json "$AV1_INPUT"`; require approved AV1 profile/level/bit depth, operating point/layers, tile, grain, color, frame types and timestamps. Record ffmpeg build/hardware capability. Run `ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel repeat+level+verbose -hwaccel "$APPROVED_HWACCEL" -hwaccel_device "$GPU_SELECTOR" -i "$AV1_INPUT" -map 0:v:0 -an -vf "$APPROVED_HW_DOWNLOAD_PIXEL_FORMAT_GRAIN_AND_COLOR_POLICY" -f framemd5 "$AV1_ACTUAL_FRAMEMD5"`; require exact NVDEC/no fallback and golden/timestamp equality under the declared grain stage. Play the complete stream on the approved connector/display mode, collect time-correlated visual evidence and final health/events. Stop on anomaly; do not retry.
test_case.expected_result: AV1 hashes and sequence/profile/level/bit-depth/operating-point/tile/grain/color metadata match; exact GPU capability and hardware decoder are proven without fallback; all frames/timestamps/signatures match the declared golden stage and ffmpeg exits 0 without parser/decode error. Physical playback has no tile seam, missing layer, unintended grain suppression/amplification, banding/color error, freeze, tearing, crop/aspect or edge artifact; health remains acceptable.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires every AV1 capability, syntax/tool, grain-stage, frame-signature, health and qualified visual check. FAIL on libaom/encode evidence substitution, unsupported required AV1 capability, fallback, syntax/parser error, operating-point/tile/grain/frame/timestamp/signature mismatch, visual defect, nonzero exit or health breach. BLOCKED at runtime when bindings are absent. End user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Reject CPU libaom encode-to-null and AV1 Encode-row artifacts as decoder evidence; prove exact device capability and no fallback.
Verify immutable media/golden and operating-point/tile/grain/color contract before workload.
Use bounded approved scratch only, preserve logs/events and uniquely tag decode artifacts.
Keep reconstructed-frame signatures distinct from connector-bound grain/color/visual proof.
Stop on media/parser/decoder/GPU/thermal/storage/display/evidence anomaly; no retry, reset, reboot, log clear or firmware change.
expected_evidence: Exact GPU architecture/identity, driver/VBIOS/ffmpeg, positive AV1 capability, selected NVDEC and no-fallback log
Complete parser/decode log, exit status, frame/timestamp accounting and exact declared-stage `framemd5` comparison
Connector/display/HDR/player identity and full-clip time-correlated qualified visual record
Decode-only tags, encode non-reuse audit, scratch/health/events, no-retry audit and verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop decoder/player on first parser, reconstruction, visual or health failure; preserve decode-only AV1 media, manifests, logs, captures and events and do not retry. Remove only approved scratch after retention; restore approved display/session state without reset, reboot or firmware action and escalate if health remains abnormal.
